data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 year of account experienced different fortunes. The calendar year loss of GBP 5.6m arose primarily from the need to strengthen reserves for a small number of major items in litigation, as well as a need to adjust various reinsurance balances. Although the most material strengthening related to the CCI book where liabilities remain the subject of ongoing legal dispute, there was also need to increase specific reserves for a small number of disputed items in the UK, Italy and the USA all of which were the subjects of adverse legal developments. As a result of that strengthening, net reserves at year end totalled GBP 17.0m.

named_events.loss_description: S102 was accepted into the 2014 year of account; S102 included significant longer tail exposures particularly within Creditor, Professional Indemnity, Political Risk and CCI books.
S1208 was accepted into the 2012 year of account; S1208 wrote a broad spread London market book including Property and various specialty classes.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (the prior-year closing balance) was GBP 7.578m. The 2014 year experienced an adverse movement driven principally by the need to strengthen reserves for litigation-exposed items and by adjustments to reinsurance balances, notably material strengthening in the CCI portfolio and increases for a small number of disputed items in the UK, Italy and the USA. The report does not provide a single explicit gross prioryear movement figure for reestimation of years before 2014, so a quantified gross prioryear development amount cannot be determined from the disclosed notes and statements.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding prior-year column). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note or gross claims development triangle was found in the disclosed pages; narrative quantifies only net movements and describes strengthening but does not give a gross prioryear figure. Prior-year development amount therefore set to null. Many amounts in the segmental analysis are small and reported in GBP 000; conversions to millions performed. RITC activity (S1208 into 2012 and S102 into 2014) may distort simple comparisons of opening vs closing gross reserves.
